value.account: Root cause: from 2.29 the lowering of loop/recur :on-exhausted (workflow_lisp/lowering/control_loops.py, _loop_on_exhausted_outputs) emitted a placeholder-step ref override for inactive-variant fields, including relpath ones; the shared validator forbids overriding relpath repeat_until outputs, giving workflow_boundary_type_invalid. Fix 1: do not emit that override for relpath-kind fields; the loop frame already carries the inactive-variant placeholder literal, which is what 2.28 does. Fixing only this exposed a second 2.29+ failure: the exhausted loop artifacts kept compiler-emitted {ref} overrides raw (e.g. result__rounds), and the 2.29+ match join reads result__rounds (2.28 read state__round), so the join failed with invalid_output_value. Fix 2: in workflow/loops.py repeat_until_exhaustion_artifacts, for workflow version >= 2.29 resolve {ref} overrides (own-frame refs from frame artifacts, other refs via executor._resolve_ref_value); versions <= 2.28 are untouched. Tests: tests/test_workflow_lisp_loop_result_paths_target_229.py runs the bug program end to end with faked providers at 2.28/2.29/2.32 for exhaustion and done paths (identical outputs), and checks a malformed provider path (../escape.md) still fails the run. Targeted related modules (rich loop values e2e, loop_recur, loop_state, exhaustion state, nested loop match, imported stdlib exhaustion) pass. Alternatives: first tried reordering the validator to accept the generated ref before the relpath rejection; it compiled but failed at runtime and loosened validation, so discarded and reverted. Not covered: no full suite run (per instructions), no resume-after-exhaustion test for the new program, no docs update, the unused placeholder step is still materialized for the path field, and only the relpath kind was special-cased (other non-scalar kinds in that branch unchanged).
value.summary: At targets 2.29-2.32 the loop result with a path field in a non-exhausted variant now compiles and exhausts exactly as at 2.28, via a lowering fix and a runtime fix, with regression tests.

notes: No se ejecutó la suite completa ni una reanudación del programa nuevo tras un commit.
El compilador sigue materializando un placeholder del relpath inactivo que este caso no consume.
